name: @ozjsey/v-observe
description: Vue 3 directive owning IntersectionObserver + ResizeObserver + MutationObserver in one binding — cross-observer gating, threshold-crossed events, diff payloads, unified state attribute
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup vObserve.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/vObserve.js dist/vObserve.min.js && mv dist/vObserve.js.map dist/vObserve.min.js.map && mv dist/vObserve.cjs dist/vObserve.min.cjs && mv dist/vObserve.cjs.map dist/vObserve.min.cjs.map && mv dist/vObserve.d.cts dist/vObserve.min.d.cts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['vObserve.min.js','vObserve.min.cjs']){const p='dist/'+f;let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=vObserve\.(js|cjs)\.map/, '//# sourceMappingURL='+f+'.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);}"
